name: Azelastine
evidence: H1 antagonist + documented mast cell stabilizer; approved as intranasal/ophthalmic anti-allergic.

name: Olopatadine
evidence: Dual H1 antagonist + mast cell stabilizer; topical ophthalmic/nasal anti-allergic.

name: Nedocromil
evidence: Cromone class; mast cell stabilizer (asthma + allergic conjunctivitis).

name: Pemirolast
evidence: Mast cell stabilizer; ophthalmic anti-allergic.

name: Tranilast
evidence: Anti-allergic + anti-fibrotic mast cell stabilizer; used in atopic dermatitis + keloid scars; cited in MCAS literature.

name: Lodoxamide
evidence: Cromone class; ophthalmic mast cell stabilizer for vernal keratoconjunctivitis.

name: Amlexanox
evidence: Cromone-like anti-allergic; topical for aphthous ulcers + asthma adjunct; IKK-epsilon inhibitor.

name: Levocetirizine
evidence: Active R-enantiomer of cetirizine; H1 antagonist.

name: Bilastine
evidence: Newer-generation H1 antagonist; minimal CNS penetration.

name: Ebastine
evidence: Long-acting H1 antagonist.

name: Mizolastine
evidence: H1 antagonist + LOX inhibition.

name: Doxepin
evidence: Tricyclic with extremely potent H1 + H2 antagonism; used for refractory urticaria.

name: Cinnarizine
evidence: H1 antagonist + Ca channel blocker; antiallergic + antivertigo.

name: Tofacitinib
evidence: JAK1/3 inhibitor; downstream of FcεRI; emerging interest in MCAS-adjacent autoimmunity.

name: Acalabrutinib
evidence: Selective BTK inhibitor; downstream of FcεRI signaling in mast cells.

name: Tacrolimus
evidence: Calcineurin inhibitor; suppresses mast cell mediator release.

name: Pimecrolimus
evidence: Topical calcineurin inhibitor; suppresses mast cell + T cell activation.

name: Hydroxychloroquine
evidence: Anti-malarial + immunomodulator; reported in some MCAS regimens.

name: Glycyrrhizin
evidence: Licorice triterpene saponin; anti-allergic + anti-inflammatory.

name: Hydroxytyrosol
evidence: Olive polyphenol; Nrf2 activator; anti-inflammatory.

name: Cysteamine
evidence: Aminothiol antioxidant; Nrf2-axis modulator; covalent through thiol-disulfide exchange.

name: Desloratadine
evidence: Active metabolite of loratadine; second-gen H1 antagonist.

name: Rupatadine
evidence: H1 antagonist + PAF antagonist; used in urticaria/allergic rhinitis.

name: Emedastine
evidence: Selective H1 antagonist; ophthalmic anti-allergic.

name: Alcaftadine
evidence: H1 antagonist with mast-cell stabilizer claims; ophthalmic.

name: Bepotastine
evidence: H1 antagonist + mast-cell stabilizer; ophthalmic/oral in some markets.

name: Epinastine
evidence: H1 antagonist with mast-cell stabilizing properties.

name: Chlorpheniramine
evidence: Classic first-gen H1 antagonist; still used in allergic disease.

name: Promethazine
evidence: First-gen H1 antagonist with strong antihistamine effect.

name: Cyproheptadine
evidence: H1 + 5-HT2 antagonist; used for allergic and serotonergic symptoms.

name: Triprolidine
evidence: First-gen H1 antagonist.

name: Zafirlukast
evidence: CysLT1 receptor antagonist; asthma / allergic disease.

name: Pranlukast
evidence: CysLT1 antagonist used in Japan for asthma/allergic rhinitis.

name: Zileuton
evidence: 5-LOX inhibitor; reduces leukotriene synthesis in asthma.

name: Ibrutinib
evidence: BTK inhibitor; FcεRI pathway; mast-cell relevance.

name: Ruxolitinib
evidence: JAK1/2 inhibitor; downstream cytokine/mast-cell-adjacent signaling.

name: Cyclosporine
evidence: Calcineurin inhibitor; suppresses mast-cell mediator release.

name: Sirolimus
evidence: mTOR inhibitor; immunomodulator used in some mast-cell disorders.

name: Dimethyl fumarate
evidence: Electrophilic Nrf2 activator (Tecfidera); KEAP1 covalent mechanism.

name: Bardoxolone methyl
evidence: Potent KEAP1/Nrf2 electrophilic activator (clinical CDDO-Me).

name: Omaveloxolone
evidence: KEAP1/Nrf2 activator approved for FA; covalent electrophilic mechanism.

name: Dasatinib
evidence: Multi-kinase / KIT-family TKI; mastocytosis literature.

name: Nilotinib
evidence: KIT/ABL TKI; systemic mastocytosis trials.

name: Ripretinib
evidence: Switch-control KIT/PDGFRA inhibitor; advanced SM / GIST.

name: Bezuclastinib
evidence: Selective KIT D816V inhibitor in SM development.

name: Oltipraz
evidence: Classical Nrf2 inducer / chemopreventive dithiolethione.

name: Tert-butylhydroquinone
evidence: Canonical Nrf2 inducer used in experimental models.

name: SFN-NAC
evidence: Major SFN mercapturic metabolite; Nrf2-axis marker compound.

name: Acrivastine
evidence: Second-generation H1 antagonist.

name: Mequitazine
evidence: H1 antagonist used in allergic rhinitis.

name: Astemizole
evidence: Withdrawn H1 antagonist; strong historical mast-cell allergy drug.

name: Terfenadine
evidence: Withdrawn prodrug H1 antagonist (fexofenadine parent).
